paragraphs: R' Chanina bar Sansan — Bereshit Rabbah 19:2.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The locator ב״ר פ״יט-ב is conventionally Bereshit Rabbah, chapter19, section2. The older literal b/unresolved-unit reading remains historical; this conventional decoding does not verify modern edition numbering.
The title before Chanina is abbreviated and retained as R'; no personal title is supplied for Sansan and no further identity is established.
